tasks.name: T1-field
tasks.inputs: audio, start time within 60 s, a 20 km search square at a random offset, public surveillance tracks
tasks.metric: hit within 1000 m; failed, crashed and missing runs are misses
tasks.released_cohort: 360 A2O batch 3 recordings at 23 sites (the test split; the blind runs' squares per recording, data/b3_blind_squares.csv); 295 A2O batch 1 and 61 batch 2 recordings; 187 Eclipse T1 clips
tasks.aggregation: per clip plus separately reported site-level controls; do not pool correlated site-days
tasks.registration: Eclipse ecl-v1; A2O a2o-v1 and dated batch3 amendments
tasks.search_square: A2O batch 3: the exact 20 km square each recording had in the blind run (data/b3_blind_squares.csv, task T1); the A2O network publishes its positions, so the square reveals nothing the source does not

tasks.name: T1-public
tasks.inputs: audio, time prior, 20 by 20 km square with seeded offset rather than a truth-centred square
tasks.metric: report 100 m, 500 m and 1000 m hit rates; legacy paper benchmark table uses 500 m; median only among answered cases
tasks.denominator: union of cases run by any method per subset/task; absent method cases are misses
tasks.note: Livermore is development data. The scorer never substitutes a fitted location for it

tasks.name: clock
tasks.inputs: known or explicitly inferred place, audio over days, public surveillance; no injected offset/drift given to the estimator
tasks.model: recorder error e(t)=a+b(t-t_set), recorder time minus UTC; drift reported seconds/day
tasks.metric: RMS offset error across clip starts and absolute drift error seconds/day; held-out-day checks retained
tasks.note: 40 indexed Livermore clips; two unreliable starts excluded by the original clock run; no new fit is run for this release

tasks.name: claim-check
tasks.inputs: audio, claimed public place and claimed UTC; no assumed clock correctness
tasks.hypotheses: whole-hour shifts -13 through +13 h and +/-24 h; each has +/-300 s clock slack
tasks.confirmed: a stated-time geometry match that is also that ridge group's best fit over every hypothesis window
tasks.shifted: no stated-time match, plus two matched groups agreeing within 8 s or one group's fit beating all other windows by a factor of 2
tasks.otherwise: undecided, no_pass, no_adsb, failed or pending as recorded
tasks.controls: same audio and clock at a 150 km decoy, known-good native clips, injected shifts and held-out iNaturalist decoys; compare within recording
tasks.note: A slip verdict is not proof that a recordist's clock or claim is wrong

tasks.name: T2-date
tasks.inputs: audio, recording date and opaque 100 km square; no known start time
tasks.metric: hits within 1000 m; all missing or failed runs remain misses
tasks.released_cohort: A2O batch 3 (360, squares in data/b3_blind_squares.csv task T2-date), A2O batch 1 (295) and Eclipse clips (187), as the original unheard date-only runs
tasks.note: Same released location references, a different input-information task. It must not be pooled with known-start T1.

tasks.name: pass-detection-distance
tasks.inputs: audio only; output received CPA seconds since clip start and slant distance metres
tasks.rule: aircraftwitness-detection-v1; deterministic maximum-cardinality one-to-one temporal matching, then minimum total absolute timing error; inclusive 10 s tolerance; no distance gate
tasks.reference: valid interpolated geometric CPA and slant where supported, otherwise observed minimum; add slant/343 s for acoustic propagation
tasks.band_edges: lower inclusive, upper exclusive except 10000 inclusive
tasks.metrics: matched labels/labels per band; unmatched detections/audio hours; absolute and signed distance error among matches
tasks.denominator: intersection of valid available surveillance cuts and existing detector output files; missing detector files are not empty predictions
tasks.limits: proximity is not proof of audibility; unmatched does not mean acoustically false; sampled surveillance, clocks and source-position uncertainty limit labels
